- C0 deterministic control (offline, 200 cases): accuracy 0.800, hard-negative FP 0.000, failure/abstain 0.200, issue_match p95 66.5312 ms; contextual-statistics update 0.000. Live: issue_match p95 65.95 ms, total-case p95 447.05 ms. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- V5 full shadow/OPE (offline, 200): accuracy 0.800, FP 0.000, failure/abstain 0.200, p95 66.3396 ms; contextual-statistics update 0.605; feedback write 80%. - V0, V2-V4 ablations (static RAG, +feedback norm, +delayed link, +theory metadata): not run; V1 deterministic ranker only: not isolated
